name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
grip: Supinated, starting with palms facing thighs or slightly forward and rotating into full supination as elbows flex.
description: Stand upright and curl two dumbbells simultaneously toward shoulder height while maintaining a stable torso and keeping the upper arms pinned at the sides.
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and knees softly unlocked.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended downward at the sides.
Engage the core and pull the shoulder blades down and back.
instructions: Curl both dumbbells upward simultaneously by flexing the elbows.
Keep the upper arms vertical and fixed against the sides of the torso.
Rotate palms into full supination facing upward near chest height.
Squeeze the biceps at peak contraction, then lower slowly back to full extension under control.
cues: Turn palms up through the curl.
Lower under strict control without swinging.
commonMistakes: Swinging the hips or using momentum to heave weights upward.
Flaring the elbows outward or allowing upper arms to drift forward.
Cutting the range of motion short at the bottom.

logging.example: Two 14 kg dumbbells: record 14 kg per dumbbell.
logging.note: Record the individual dumbbell mass rather than the combined load of the pair.

variantNote: Standing bilateral variant. In the illustration, the starting pose shows dumbbells hanging at the sides with relaxed wrists before rotating into full supination at the peak.
